g.text: S01-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
local write transaction: lock before grant reads
All checks precede saveRole/saveEdges; actor facts still precede mutation.
no pre-planted path to SUPER_ADMIN; permission-set inclusion alone is insufficient.
Transaction proxy commits only normal return.
Any exception aborts: no edge/version/SUCCESS fact persists.
